00:30 surprise: The creator shows a bright-looking arm after washing and reacts to the appearance.
reason: The bold one-use and three-use claims could prompt reactions or discussion, while the soap demonstration and ingredient list offer some practical viewing value.
00:00 surprising: The claim that neighbors did not recognize the creator is an attention-grabbing conversation starter.
00:10 other: Specific claims about results after one or three uses could invite viewers to debate or share their own experiences.
00:16 useful_tip: The ingredient names and soap-lather demonstration provide product information viewers may pass along.
